s01.title: The Unknown Passage
s01.text: The road ahead splits in two. One path is shown clearly on your map, well-travelled and familiar. The other is an unmarked passage disappearing into shadow, its destination unknown.

choices.text: Follow the familiar road shown on the map.
Investigate the unfamiliar passage.

s01a.title: The Familiar Road
s01a.text: You keep to the known road. It is uneventful, but steady progress carries you back toward the main route ahead.

choices.text: Continue onward.

s01b.title: The Unmarked Passage
s01b.text: The passage twists beneath old stone, revealing a hidden chamber before opening back out onto the main route ahead.

choices.text: Continue onward.

s02.title: The Locked Mechanism
s02.text: A locked mechanism blocks the way. An old set of instructions describes one method of opening it, but the device looks like it might respond to something else entirely.

choices.text: Try the conventional method described in the instructions.
Experiment with an unusual approach.

s03.title: The Strange Artifact
s03.text: Half-buried in the ground, you spot an object unlike anything you recognise. Its purpose isn't obvious.

choices.text: Leave it alone — its purpose can't be determined.
Examine it and try to understand what it might be.

s04.title: Preparing for the Journey
s04.text: One evening remains before a dangerous stretch of the journey begins.

choices.text: Spend the evening preparing supplies and checking the route.
Rest instead and deal with things as they come.

s05.title: The Failed Mechanism
s05.text: An ancient mechanism resists your first attempt to open it. It sits still, unmoved.

choices.text: Examine what went wrong and try again.
Abandon the mechanism and find another way forward.

s05a.title: A Second Attempt
s05a.text: Studying the mechanism's failure more closely, you adjust your approach. This time, something shifts — the way ahead opens.

choices.text: Continue onward.

s05b.title: A Different Route
s05b.text: You leave the mechanism behind and find an alternate way around, rejoining the main path further ahead.

choices.text: Continue onward.

s06.title: The Commitment
s06.text: You promised a companion that an important task would be finished before sunset. Partway through, it's clear it will take longer than planned.

choices.text: Continue working until the commitment is completed.
Stop and move on to another opportunity that has appeared.

s07.title: The Travellers
s07.text: At the edge of a settlement, a group of travellers is preparing for their own expedition.

choices.text: Introduce yourself and ask about joining them.
Continue your journey independently.

s08.title: Speaking Your Mind
s08.text: The group is deciding what to do next. You strongly disagree with the plan being discussed.

choices.text: Explain your concerns openly and suggest an alternative.
Keep your concerns to yourself and go along with the group.

s09.title: The Stranger's Question
s09.text: A stranger approaches and asks what brought you to the region.

choices.text: Engage openly and tell them about your journey.
Give a brief answer and avoid discussing yourself.

s10.title: The Injured Traveller
s10.text: You find an injured traveller on the road. You have enough supplies for yourself, but sharing them will make your own journey harder.

choices.text: Give the traveller some supplies and help them recover.
Keep the supplies — they may be needed later.

s11.title: The Divided Group
s11.text: Your companions strongly disagree about how to proceed.

choices.text: Try to find a solution that addresses everyone's concerns.
Argue for the option you personally believe is best.

s12.title: The Companion
s12.text: Escaping an ambush, one companion is struggling to keep pace with the group.

choices.text: Slow down so the companion can stay with you.
Continue with the group at full speed.

s12a.title: Staying Together
s12a.text: You match your pace to your companion's. It costs time, but the group reaches safety together, and the path continues ahead.

choices.text: Continue onward.

s12b.title: Pressing Ahead
s12b.text: The group moves quickly and reaches safety without delay. The path continues ahead.

choices.text: Continue onward.

s13.title: After the Danger
s13.text: A dangerous event has passed. The immediate threat is over.

choices.text: Keep thinking about what happened and worry it may return.
Accept that the danger has passed and focus on what comes next.

s14.title: The Aftermath
s14.text: You notice yourself replaying the dangerous encounter over and over.

choices.text: Remain preoccupied, worrying something similar will happen again.
Acknowledge what happened, learn from it, and move on.

s15.title: Under Pressure
s15.text: A crucial plan suddenly goes wrong.

choices.text: The setback becomes overwhelming, making it hard to decide what to do.
Regain composure and concentrate on the immediate problem.

s_end.title: Journey's End
s_end.text: Your adventure draws to a close here. The next chapter is still being written.
